name: SIGN
description: SIGN returns the sign of a number: 1 if the number is positive, 0 if zero, and -1 if negative.
tldr: Returns 1, 0, or -1 indicating a number's sign.

parameters.name: number
parameters.description: The real number whose sign you want to determine.

advancedExamples.title: Sign of zero
advancedExamples.explanation: Zero is neither positive nor negative, so SIGN returns 0.

howItWorks: SIGN evaluates the sign of the input: it returns 1 when number > 0, 0 when number = 0, and -1 when number < 0. It is often combined with other functions to branch logic.

howToSteps.name: Select the cell
howToSteps.text: Click the cell for the result.

limitations: SIGN only returns -1, 0, or 1; it does not indicate magnitude.
It is not affected by formatting or rounding; only the value's sign matters.

googleSheetsEquivalent.description: SIGN works identically in Google Sheets.

faq.question: What does SIGN return for zero?
faq.answer: It returns 0, since zero has no sign.

faq.question: How is SIGN useful?
faq.answer: It lets you apply different calculations depending on whether a value is positive, zero, or negative, often inside IF or other formulas.

faq.question: Does SIGN round the number first?
faq.answer: No. SIGN only looks at the sign of the exact value; -0.0001 still returns -1.
